I have only this small piece of land, and at my age I must work it carefully with what I already have. The soil is sandy here in Mtwara, so I will spread manure from my goats to give the maize some strength, but I cannot afford chemical fertilizer from town. I keep my own seed from last season, and my children and I will weed with our hand-hoes when the rains come; we do not need to hire anyone for a plot this size.
